information_contract: All policies receive the same calibrated risk interval, candidate nodes, reach ensemble, consequence weights, cutoff and budget. Adaptive SDAIF and adaptive Bayesian receive each result only after selecting that test.
claim_boundary: Constructed E. coli-referenced risk plus public benchmark hydraulics; no field or municipal validation.
negative_result_rule: No superiority claim unless the paired 95% interval is above zero; equivalence is reported separately.
